Both captured scipy.linalg initializers import from _decomp, whose captured __all__ lists eigh and whose module-level eigh declaration is supplied on both sides. The call is conditional on the dense solver branch; these selectors name its captured declaration candidates.

The direct import from scipy.sparse.linalg is connected by the captured _eigen and arpack package re-exports to the arpack module. The captured module exports and declares eigsh on both sides. The consumer invokes this binding in the arpack solver branch.
